title: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id,
question: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id, who have the highest number of delivered orders, and provide the average payment value, city, and state for each of these customers.

prediction.sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id
    FROM olist_orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(d.order_id) AS delivered_order_count
    FROM olist_customers c
    JOIN delivered_orders d ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
top_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id
    FROM customer_order_counts
    ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       AVG(p.payment_value) AS avg_payment_value,
       c.customer_city,
       c.customer_state
FROM olist_customers c
JOIN delivered_orders d ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
JOIN olist_order_payments p ON d.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top_customers)
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_city, c.customer_state
ORDER BY c.customer_unique_id;

       AVG(p.payment_value) AS avg_payment,
       c.customer_city,

FROM olist_customers c
